findings.title: Identity Document Does Not Match Client

source.text: Verification form states client is 'Joe Bloggs' but attached passport shows 'SUMMERS, BENEDICT JAMES LAWRENCE'

reference.text: the client is the person he or she claims to be, for example, by a current signed passport or current UK photo driving licence or by using an electronic ID system

findings.deviation: The passport on file belongs to a different person than the client. This is a fundamental CDD failure - the wrong identity document has been verified and attached to the matter file.
